artifact_inspected: Inventory module: products.tsx, summary.tsx, adjustments.tsx, src/lib/inventory.ts, hooks, and 14 full-page screenshots across 3 viewports

defects_found.description: Round-to-zero adjustment quantities (0.0001) initially accepted; fixed in phase 5 re-verification with rounded===0 guard and regression tests
Adjustments list lacked pagination controls when >20 movements; fixed by wiring PAGE_SIZE + Pagination component

Products page search input bypassed sanitizeSearchTerm and page state was unreachable (usePagination without rendered control); fixed in phase-6 independent review by sanitizing at the useProducts call and wiring Pagination, re-verified by tests and Playwright re-run
Summary/adjustments table numeric text used 600-shade colors failing AA contrast; darkened to 700-shade tokens in phase-6 review, confirmed by axe re-run
Pre-existing shared-chrome a11y findings (Header icon buttons without names, slate-500 sidebar contrast, duplicate nav landmarks) surfaced by axe but out of increment scope

refinement_actions: Single-sourced stock status color from stockStatus() so summary table text and badge can never disagree
Stripped ILIKE/fts metacharacters from search terms before filter interpolation
Added negative-stock confirmation gate with second-quantity re-check in adjustments flow
Filed sidebar a11y debt (button aria-labels, contrast) as explicit follow-up outside this increment

sources_consulted.name: Supabase PostgREST filters reference
sources_consulted.purpose: Canonical grammar and escaping rules for or()/ilike filter strings that the search sanitization must not break

sources_consulted.name: TanStack Query placeholder data guide
sources_consulted.purpose: keepPreviousData pattern so paginated and searched tables do not flash empty during refetch

sources_consulted.name: Supabase Row Level Security intro
sources_consulted.purpose: Default-deny policy posture used to validate the movements table access audit in the threat model

patterns_adopted: dense data-table dashboard layout with one primary action button per page header
status badges color-coded by semantic state tokens instead of inline styles
filter toolbar above table with left-aligned compact select controls
confirmation dialog interrupting destructive or out-of-range operations
local_design_decisions: reuse the existing project component library (Table, Badge, Modal, Input, Select, Pagination, ConfirmDialog) rather than introducing new primitives
derive both the stock badge and the current-stock text color from one shared stockStatus helper so thresholds cannot diverge visually
keep adjustment quantity input as a single signed field with plus/minus semantics explained inline, matching operator mental models from the physical count workflow
patterns_rejected: card-grid overview tiles for every metric, which the established dense-table design language of this admin tool does not use
